title: Flail chest
claims: Flail chest: ≥3 adjacent ribs each fractured in ≥2 places, producing a free-floating segment (definitions vary: ATLS uses ≥2 adjacent ribs).
Paradoxical motion: the segment moves inward on inspiration and outward on expiration.
Hypoxia is driven mainly by the underlying pulmonary contusion and pain-limited breathing, not the paradoxical motion itself.
Management: oxygen, analgesia (including regional blocks), judicious fluids; ventilatory support if failing; rib fixation in selected patients.
